headline: This remote-controlled wagon is silly but so very useful
summary: BougeRV's remote-controlled DuneRover wagon features animated lighting. Despite initial skepticism, it proved incredibly capable and useful. It can carry over 200 pounds and tackle hills with powerful torque.

headline: Gemini Call for Me might tell your mom you’re running late
summary: Google may expand its 'Call for Me' AI feature to personal calls. The 'Gemini Calling' function could automate messages to friends and family. Examples include telling family you're running 15 minutes late.

headline: Reverse-engineered games: All the news on video game decomps, recomps, VR and web and 3D ports
summary: Retro gaming is experiencing a boom thanks to game decompilations and recompilations. Classic titles are being freed from original hardware, allowing ports to new devices. This enables creative mods, like skateboarding in Call of Duty or playing Halo in VR.

headline: The Matic is the first robovac to get an FCC ban waiver, not that it needs it
summary: The Matic, a popular robot vacuum and mop, has received an FCC ban waiver. It's the first robovac to 'escape' the FCC's 'Roomba ban,' though it was never banned. The FCC conditionally approved the Matic and its charging dock on October 2nd.

headline: The Marvel Legends Daredevil: Born Again Mask Is on Sale Just In Time for Halloween
summary: A Marvel Legends Daredevil: Born Again mask is currently available on sale. This discount is perfectly timed for Halloween enthusiasts. Fans can grab the iconic mask for costumes or collector displays.

headline: The LEGO Icons Project Hail Mary Set Gets Its First Discount During Big Deal Days
summary: The popular LEGO Icons Project Hail Mary set is now on sale. This marks the first discount for the set during 'Big Deal Days.' LEGO fans can take advantage of the reduced price.

headline: The 18 Best Prime Big Deal Days Gaming Deals — Hand-Picked by Our Deals Experts
summary: Amazon's Prime Big Deal Days offer substantial discounts on gaming products. Experts have curated the top 18 gaming deals available. Find savings on PS5, Switch 2, and Xbox titles, including upcoming 2026 releases.

headline: Absolute Batman Comics Are Buy 2, Get 1 Free at Amazon Today
summary: Amazon is offering a 'Buy 2, Get 1 Free' promotion on Absolute Batman Comics. This deal allows collectors to expand their graphic novel library. The offer is available for a limited time today.

headline: Trump says 'threat' led US to pull bombers from RAF Fairford
summary: Donald Trump claims a 'threat' prompted the US to remove bombers from RAF Fairford. The Pentagon confirmed the B1 bombers returned to their home stations. The aircraft were previously stationed at the base in England.

headline: France braces for national day of school protests after injuries and mass arrests
summary: France is preparing for a nationwide day of school protests. Students are demanding increased investment and resources for education. The planned demonstrations follow recent student injuries and mass arrests.

headline: Author and former politician Jeffrey Archer dies aged 86
summary: Jeffrey Archer, the acclaimed author and former politician, has passed away at 86. He sold over 300 million books during his five-decade writing career. His final novel, 'Adam and Eve,' was set for release this month.

headline: Rise in babies in care proceedings raises fears of unnecessary adoptions, experts tell BBC
summary: Experts express concern over a rise in babies entering care proceedings. This trend is fueling fears of potentially unnecessary adoptions. 'File on 4 Investigates' reports that better support could keep many babies out of care.
